title: Bhakoot dosha: meaning, cancellation and myths | Ask Tota
description: Bhakoot dosha is 0 of 7 points when two Moon signs sit 2/12, 5/9 or 6/8 apart. Why half of all couples get it, and the classical cancellations.
og_title: Bhakoot dosha, and why half of couples have it
og_description: Six of the twelve possible Moon sign distances score zero on bhakoot. The three types, what each is said to affect, and the rules that cancel it.
h1: bhakoot dosha hits half of all couples. here is what it measures, and what cancels it
dek: bhakoot is the 7 point koota in guna milan, scored from how far apart two moon signs are. three of the six distance pairs score zero, which means about half of all random couples have bhakoot dosha before any cancellation is checked.

llms_desc: what bhakoot koota measures in Ashtakoota guna milan (Moon sign distance, 7 points), the three bhakoot dosha types (2/12 dwirdwadash, 5/9 navam-pancham, 6/8 shadashtak), why about half of random couples have it, classical cancellation rules, and myths.

faq.a: a zero score in bhakoot, the 7 point koota of ashtakoota guna milan. it happens when the two partners' moon signs are 2 and 12, 5 and 9, or 6 and 8 signs apart counted from each other.

faq.q: how many points is bhakoot worth?
faq.a: 7 out of 36. it is the second highest koota after nadi, which is worth 8. bhakoot scores either 7 or 0, with no partial scores in the standard system.
very common. of the twelve possible distances between two moon signs, six fall into the dosha pairs. so roughly half of random couples have bhakoot dosha before cancellations are checked.
the 6/8 form of bhakoot dosha, where the moon signs are six and eight signs apart. it is traditionally treated as the most serious of the three and linked to friction and health concerns.

the 5/9 form, with moon signs five and nine apart. traditionally linked to matters around children. many astrologers treat it as the mildest, since 5 and 9 are trines that are favourable elsewhere in astrology.
the 2/12 form, with moon signs two and twelve apart, meaning adjacent signs. traditionally linked to finances and expenses.

common cancellations: both moon signs ruled by the same planet, such as aries and scorpio under mars; the two sign lords being natural friends; and in some traditions, a strong score in other kootas or a friendly navamsa relationship.

faq.q: can i marry with bhakoot dosha?
faq.a: many couples do. classical texts list cancellations, and even uncancelled, bhakoot is one factor in a matching system that itself is one part of chart comparison. a full reading looks at both charts, not just the koota score.

faq.q: is bhakoot dosha worse than nadi dosha?
faq.a: nadi carries 8 points and is usually treated as weightier. both are binary kootas that score full or zero. both have classical cancellation rules.

faq.q: what is a good bhakoot relationship?
faq.a: same sign, 3/11, 4/10, or 7/7. these score the full 7. the 7/7 relationship, moons in opposite signs, is often read as especially complementary.

faq.q: does bhakoot dosha apply if we have the same moon sign?
faq.a: no. the same moon sign is a 1/1 relationship, which scores the full 7 points for bhakoot. other kootas such as nadi may still need checking.

faq.q: is bhakoot dosha a real problem?
faq.a: it is a traditional indicator within a traditional system. no controlled research shows koota scores predict marriage outcomes. treat it as one prompt for conversation, not a verdict on a relationship.
